hero.title: Custom cakes and desserts in Kraków
hero.lead: Made from fresh ingredients for your occasion: birthday, wedding, christening or a cosy evening with family. Tell us what you'd like and we'll send an exact price.

items.d: Cream, real chocolate, cream cheese and fruit. No margarine or artificial flavourings.
Price per kg is listed on the site. Decoration is quoted before you order, so no surprises at pickup.
We'll recreate an idea from a photo or create one together: from minimal to tiered wedding cakes.
Hundreds of families in Kraków trust us. Read the reviews before you order.
Date, number of guests, flavour and design ideas. You can add an inspiration photo.
We reply, agree on the design and give you the exact price including decoration.
A {deposit} deposit secures your date. Pay the rest at pickup by card or cash.
Pickup at Białoruska 7 or delivery by taxi at taxi rates.

calc.title: How much cake do you need?
calc.lead: We plan 150–200 g per guest. Pick a flavour and the number of guests to see an estimate.
calc.tier2: Can be made as a 2-tier cake
calc.tier3: Can be made as a 3-tier cake

prices.title: Prices
prices.lead: Cakes are priced by weight: flavour price × kilograms + decoration. Minimum weight is shown next to each flavour.

rules.d: Cakes from 2 kg, some flavours from 1.5 kg.
We charge at most 300 g over (4–7 kg cakes – 500 g), the rest is on us.

reviews.title: What clients say
reviews.lead: We don't write reviews ourselves. They are all public on Google Maps.

items.q: How far in advance should I order?
items.a: Usually {leadTime} days ahead. For weddings and big events, book your date a few weeks in advance. Need it urgently? Message us, sometimes we have free slots.

items.q: How much does a decorated cake cost?
items.a: Price = weight × flavour price + decoration. For example, a 2.5 kg Raspberry cake: 2.5 × 130 = 325 zł plus decoration. Decoration depends on complexity, so we quote it once we see your idea.

items.q: What size cake should I choose?
items.a: 150–200 g per guest. For 15 guests that's 2.3–3 kg. For weddings about 150 g per person is enough, as there are other desserts too. Try the calculator above.
Once the design and price are agreed, you pay a {deposit} deposit by bank transfer. It secures your date. You pay the rest at pickup by card or cash.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.a: Design details can be changed until we start baking. If your plans change, tell us as early as possible and we'll find a solution.
Pickup at Plac targowy „Manhattan”, Białoruska 7, unit 12. We can also send the cake by taxi within Kraków at taxi rates.

items.q: Can you make a cake from a photo?
items.a: Yes. Send us an inspiration photo and we'll tell you what's possible and how much it costs. We don't copy cakes one-to-one, we make them in our own style.
Mention allergies in your request. Cakes may contain nuts, milk, eggs and gluten. We'll suggest suitable flavours.

items.q: How do I transport and store the cake?
items.a: Hold the box from the bottom and keep it on a flat surface (car floor or boot, with air conditioning in summer). Keep refrigerated and take it out 20–30 minutes before serving. Cut with a long, warmed knife.
Yes, include your invoice details in the request or message.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
body: Form data (name, phone, date, preferences) is used only to answer your request and fulfil the order (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). We keep it as long as the order and accounting rules require.
The form may be sent through an email delivery service (Web3Forms) or open WhatsApp. We do not sell your data or share it with others for their marketing.
Statistics (Google Analytics) and advertising (Meta Pixel) cookies are enabled only after your consent. You can change your choice any time via the “Cookie settings” link in the footer.
You have the right to access, correct, delete and restrict processing of your data, and to complain to the Polish data protection authority (Prezes UODO). Email us to exercise these rights.
